name: T3 Code Sender Identity Proxy
description: Runs t3c-proxy under s6-overlay in front of a shared T3 Code server, so that each message shows who sent it. Exposes one hostname for each person when the t3code-server and Caddy Features supply a DNS name.

version.description: npm version of @wyrd-company/t3code-proxy: `latest` or an exact version.

configPath.description: Absolute path of the config file in the container, passed to `t3c-proxy --config`. You supply the file, for example with a bind mount.

serviceUser.description: User account to run the service as. `automatic` prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.
